m.d: A small person or thing is not big. It doesn't have much size.
m.e: A mouse is a small animal. A baby mouse is very small.

m.d: Someone who is smart shows intelligence.
m.e: My friend is really smart; he has an IQ of 152.

m.d: The way a thing smells; the substance in the air that people can smell.
m.e: The smell of the flowers is very good.

m.d: If you smell something, you use the nose to sense it.
m.e: She put her nose near the flowers and breathed in to smell them.

m.d: If something smells, it gently put a substance that people can smell into the air.
m.e: The flowers smell very good.

m.d: Smoke is the gray or black substance that goes up into the air when something burns.
m.e: The smoke from that factory is making me sick.

m.d: A cigarette.
A light grey colour tinted with blue.
If somebody is smoking, they are breathing in smoke, usually from a cigarette.
m.e: Excuse me, you can't smoke in the restaurant.

m.d: If something is smoking, it is making smoke.
m.e: The fire's still smoking. You'd better put some more water on it.

m.d: The act of smiling; the form of one's mouth when one is smiling.
m.e: A visit to the fair always brings a smile to my face.

m.d: To put one's mouth in a form which shows that one is happy; to have the sides of one's mouth higher than the middle.
m.e: She smiled at me. I think she likes me!

m.d: Smith is a male given name.
m.e: Smith got a job as a CEO.

m.d: Smith is a surname.
m.e: I was looking for Mr. Smith.

m.d: A smith is a craftsman who works metal into different shapes using tools, such as a hammer.
Smooth feels pleasant and flat when you touch it; not rough.
m.e: He felt the smooth skin on her cheek.

m.d: A smooth liquid would have no lumps in it.
m.e: He mixed the flour and water until it was smooth.

m.d: A smash is a new and very successful book, movie, song, etc.
The sound of something smashing.
m.e: The loud smash made them feel fear, but it was only some plates falling.

m.d: If you smash something, you break it into many small parts.
m.e: He used a hammer to smash the glass of the window.

m.d: An act of slapping someone hard.
m.e: I smacked him for talking back to me.

m.d: A smoked food is preserved or cured by exposing it in smoke.
m.e: smoked salmon

m.d: Smuggling is an act of being smuggled.
m.e: The smuggling of immigrants has increased alarmingly.

m.d: If something is done smoothly, it is done in a smooth manner.
If something is smelly, it has a strong and unpleasant smell.
If you feel smug, you show too much pride for something you did.
If you smuggle something, you transport goods without paying taxes or duties.
m.e: He has been smuggling cigarettes from the United Kingdom to France.

m.d: If you smear a substance on a surface, you spread it by rubbing.
If you smear a person, you say bad things about them, that are false.
m.e: There is a online campaign to smear the president.

A smoothie is a smooth, thick, drink usually made with fruit, ice cream, and yogurt.
If a place is smokey, it is filled with smoke.

m.d: If a something has a smokey color, it has the color similar to that of smoke.
If a something has a 'smokey flavor, it has a taste or odor like smoke.

m.d: A smelt is a small fish of the family Osmeridae.
If you smelt something, you fuse or melt two or more different things into one.
If you smother a fire, you suffocate it by reducing its oxygen supply.
A smudge is a dirty mark.
m.e: He rubbed the smudge off the glass.

m.d: If you smudge something, you rub something in or make it dirty.
m.e: The painter accidentally smudged his painting.
